experiment_data.hypothesis: CED scoring ablation: top_k=3 (vs top_k=1). More training data (~8000 samples) vs stricter selection (2718 samples). Retry with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 (NLI model cached locally).

reproduce.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp && rm -rf /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_filtered_topk3/* && HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 python -m freige.training.rsft_score_filter --input_dir /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_generations --output_path /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_filtered_topk3 --nli_model_path cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-base --nli_device cuda:0 --selection_strategy top_k --top_k 3 --f1_threshold 0.1 --tau 0.5"

experiment_data.notes: CED scoring top_k=3 完成。8037 samples selected (vs top_k=1 的 2718, 2.96x)，selection_rate=37.0%，覆盖 2691/2716 docs (99.1%)。Selected 均值: CED=0.621 (vs topk1 0.668, -4.7pp), F1=0.576, combined=0.679。质量略低于 topk1（CED 均值降 4.7pp），但数据量增 3x。Format reward 100% pass。1924 truncated generations (mean F1=0.332 vs non-truncated 0.493)。输出: /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_filtered_topk3/rsft_train.jsonl
